query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'prompt_input',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','run-d-tone-prompt-v1','project_id','kubdiqdhqbhwmqfditeg','account',jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'subscription_tier',a.subscription_tier),'business',jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'account_id',b.account_id,'name',b.name,'category',b.category,'tone',b.tone,'products_services',b.products_services,'staff_names',b.staff_names,'highlight_facts',b.highlight_facts,'avoid_facts',b.avoid_facts,'sample_responses',b.sample_responses),'review',jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'business_id',r.business_id,'reviewer_name',r.reviewer_name,'star_rating',r.star_rating,'review_text',r.review_text,'review_date',r.review_date,'detected_language',r.detected_language),'voice_examples','[]'::jsonb,'triage_severity',r.triage_severity),'response',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'text',s.response_text,'status',s.status,'version',s.version,'provider',s.llm_provider,'model',s.llm_model,'created_at',s.created_at,'approval_method',s.approval_method,'posted_at',s.posted_at) FROM responses s WHERE s.review_id=r.id),'costs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'provider',c.provider,'endpoint',c.endpoint,'response_id',c.response_id,'cost_usd',c.cost_usd,'latency_ms',c.latency_ms,'input_tokens',c.input_tokens,'output_tokens',c.output_tokens,'created_at',c.created_at,'prompt_version',c.prompt_version,'system_prompt_hash',c.system_prompt_hash)) FROM api_costs c JOIN responses s ON s.id=c.response_id WHERE s.review_id=r.id),'run_steps',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('run_id',ar.id,'run_status',ar.status,'started_at',ar.started_at,'step_id',st.id,'step_key',st.step_key,'step_status',st.status,'latency_ms',st.latency_ms,'detail',st.detail,'created_at',st.created_at) ORDER BY st.step_index) FROM agent_runs ar JOIN agent_run_steps st ON st.agent_run_id=ar.id WHERE ar.account_id=a.id AND ar.subject_id=r.id::text),'voice_updated_at',b.updated_at) AS evidence FROM reviews r JOIN businesses b ON b.id=r.business_id JOIN accounts a ON a.id=b.account_id WHERE r.id='01a09caf-8108-73db-8cd3-a5dcf3dc6dce' AND a.id='019f43d0-0000-7000-8000-000000000001';
